OneStreamer-Core-SourceVideo
	

Video assets for the OneStreamer-Core annotations in MCG-NJU/OneStreamer-1M. See its dataset card for the task taxonomy and metadata format, and our paper for the data construction pipeline.
The release is organized by source directly under the repository root. Each uncompressed part-XXXXX.tar has a corresponding part-XXXXX.manifest.json; download them as a pair. The source videos remain subject to their respective source datasets' terms.
